## Context / Problem

`.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml:68-184,397` invokes external actions in a workflow with contents/actions-write and OIDC capability. Existing actionlint covers all workflows, but `Makefile` does not require zizmor to inspect this credentialed workflow and the focused pin contract covers only release workflow behavior.

## Approach

Replace every non-relative/external `uses:` reference in `.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml`—including `actions/checkout`, `actions/setup-python`, and `actions/cache`, as well as third-party actions—with an exact 40-hex commit SHA followed by a readable version comment. Edit `Makefile` so `ZIZMOR_WORKFLOWS` unconditionally includes `.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml`; do not widen scope conditionally or only when a tool happens to discover it. Extend `tests/unit/test_release_workflow_pins.py` (or its renamed focused successor) to parse that workflow and reject each external `uses:` value unless it matches `^[0-9a-f]{40}\s+#\s+[^\n]+$`.

## Scope

- `.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml`
- `Makefile` — add the workflow to `ZIZMOR_WORKFLOWS`.
- `tests/unit/test_release_workflow_pins.py` — enforce the full-SHA plus readable-version-comment contract for the workflow.

## Testing

Run the focused pin test with both a mutable-tag negative control and an unannotated-SHA negative control. Run the existing `make lint` actionlint/zizmor path and confirm zizmor receives the reconciliation workflow.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every external `uses:` reference in `.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml`, including first-party `actions/*`, has an exact 40-hex SHA followed by a readable version comment.
- [ ] `Makefile` unconditionally includes `.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml` in `ZIZMOR_WORKFLOWS`.
- [ ] The focused pin test fails for both a mutable tag and a 40-hex SHA without a readable version comment in that workflow.
- [ ] The focused test and existing actionlint/zizmor checks pass with the pinned workflow.
